integrity: Analytic argument is independent of finite code. The prior ternary layer lower bound is explicitly credited; only the universal matching upper bound is asserted as new.
scientific_limitations: Finite real supremum norms only; no full extremizer classification or complex-case upper bound. The 2022 survey full chapter was inaccessible. An earlier 2021 article is relevant but its exact first-public day was not verified (an indexed record gives April 2021); the exact dated source anchor is the 2024-02-20 arXiv submission, not its journal issue. Novelty relative to unindexed results remains uncertain.
title: Exact clique number of the real Birkhoff–James orthograph of \(\ell_\infty^n\)
